# The way a root node makes a pruned create's mount namespace by default follows this record (decision 6's update,
# "the faster path is the default"). hex-runtime reads this file at build time (mntns::RECORD); change the record
# and the default follows, with nothing else to edit.
#
# One line per way: the way (copy, empty, tree), then its create p50 through the seam in ms on a Linux 7.1+ bench
# host of record and the run that measured it, or `unmeasured`. All three measured in one record, the lines stand in
# the order its reader ranked them (mntns_record.py, the lead's rule of 2026-11-09: by create p50 where a sign test on
# the rounds below shows a difference at the record's 95%, else by part 19 p99 at the heaviest load, then create p99
# there), and the default is the first of them the node can take. Otherwise it is the prediction, in order of
# preference, with its basis.
#
# Goal 17's record (mntns-host-20261109T171050Z at 0c29b3ec, adacachy2, Linux 7.3.3; phase B, the three ways alone, 2
# passes at 6 and 12 busy loops, 299 rounds each): no way's create p50 is below each other's at 95% (copy below tree
# in 658 of 1,196 rounds, below empty in 604, tree below empty in 533; 627 needed), so the tail ranks them: part 19 p99
# at 12 loops, best of 2, copy 183 us, empty 243, tree 457 (the other pass: 211, 294, 246). The copy leads, then empty,
# below tree by p50 at 95% once the copy is placed, then tree.
copy 0.382 mntns-host-20261109T171050Z 0c29b3ec
empty 0.380 mntns-host-20261109T171050Z 0c29b3ec
tree 0.386 mntns-host-20261109T171050Z 0c29b3ec
prediction: tree copy empty
# The prediction's basis, which a record with a way unmeasured would fall back to: mount-lock holds a lifecycle, tree 3,
# copy 5, empty 5 (docs/research/runtime/goal6-mntns.md §4); empty last, since a 7.0 kernel serves it with the copy
# after a refused clone.
